primary_title: Cutting edge: IL-17D, a novel member of the IL-17 family, stimulates cytokine production and inhibits hemopoiesis
decision_basis: The reviews identify the cited primary as showing that purified IL-17D stimulates cytokine production by endothelial cells.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded endothelial cytokine-output edge; preserve purified recombinant ligand and endothelial-cell context, and do not infer the unresolved receptor or SCI relevance.

primary_title: Cutting edge: IL-17D, a novel member of the IL-17 family, stimulates cytokine production and inhibits hemopoiesis
decision_basis: The reviews identify the cited primary as showing that purified IL-17D stimulates IL-8 production by endothelial cells and that the increased IL-8 expression is NF-kB-dependent.
limitations_preserved: Promote as an endothelial protein-output edge with bounded NF-kB association; distinguish released IL-8 protein from CXCL8 transcript and CXCR1/CXCR2 signaling, and do not infer a direct IL17D receptor relay.
